answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore identity and evaluate an epoch-scoped polynomial, committing to its coefficients without exposing the secret. Rate-limit proofs bind each message to an epoch nullifier; a second use yields distinct Shamir shares at that nullifier, allowing recovery of the private key. The protocol verifies the exposure and instantly slashes bonded collateral, making Sybil identities costly. A plume of sable credentials cannot hide at the wharf of duplicate proofs.
